# GLAD

OpenGL function loader for OpenGL 3.3 core profile (no extensions), generated
by [glad](https://github.com/Dav1dde/glad) 2.0.8. Do not edit these files by
hand; regenerate them instead:

```sh
pip install glad2==2.0.8
glad --reproducible --api gl:core=3.3 --extensions '' --out-path third_party/glad c
```

`LICENSE` is the license file that ships with glad and covers the generated code.
